caption.text:
I’ve been fishing my entire life but never like today…

I am in a traditional fishing village on the coastline of Colombia where many of the fisherman still catch their meal every day. The coastline is gorgeous, with massive rock formations in multiple different hues of grey and blue.

How “traditional” is it here? Well:

1. The guys here do not use poles, just wooden circles with thick line on it that they throw out and pull in by hand (pic 3).

2. We are in a tiny little boat with a motor that cut out about & had to be fixed when we first started (pic that they are currently working on right now (pic 6).

3. We are using spark plugs for sinkers, which really tickles me (pic 10).

My inner redneck is smiling from ear to ear. There is high value in being low class 🇨🇴🎣❤️ #joefelz #experience #colombia #fishing #traditional
Riding a public bus as a barefoot gringo on a Saturday night is a legit experience 🇨🇴🚎🌝 #joefelz #traveker #colombia

This is a legit fishing village, traditional as they come- check the nets they have set out every morning.

Gonna go out on a boat tomorrow & try hand lining for the first time. Pretty excited to experience this new vibe 🇨🇴🎣🏝️ #joefelz #colombia #travel #culture

CHICKEN PEOPLE HELLLLLPPPP🚨🚨🚨

I’ll explain the whole story later- but we have one baby chick- hatched approximately 3-4 hours ago. Not opening his eyes, labored breathing, limp mostly unless you ruff him up a bit and the he’ll start peeping. 

I’ve got him separated from the rest, currently nestled in between my boobs for warmth since we don’t have a heat lamp. Gave him a dropper of raw yolk, salt and sugar. He took that down pretty well.

What else can I do for him?!?! #buildingreality #babychickens #chickens #homesteading #help

Most modern society is consumed with modern things but I am NOT & I never miss a chance to look upon something ancient. 

Cali, Colombia has a stellar archaeology museum with fantastic pieces from multiple ages. Just look at them and think: what were they trying to say with their creations?

Look at the faces, the eyes, the triangles & geometry. There is constant repetition of numerology & allegorical animal references. 

The question I ask myself is this: what were the artists thinking when they made these? What are they trying to tell us wordlessly from centuries ago? 🇨🇴🏺💭 #joefelz #thinker #archaeology #indigenous
